verses.t: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree
verses.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination
verses.yusufAli: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power
verses.rodwell: VERILY, we have caused It to descend on the night of POWER
verses.sale: Verily We sent down the Koran in the night of al Kadr

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is
verses.rodwell: And who shall teach thee what the night of power is
verses.sale: And what shall make thee understand how excellent the night of al Kadr is

verses.t: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months
verses.pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months
verses.yusufAli: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months
verses.rodwell: The night of power excelleth a thousand months
verses.sale: The night of al Kadr is better than a thousand months

verses.t: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter
verses.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees
verses.yusufAli: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand
verses.rodwell: Therein descend the angels and the spirit by permission of their Lord for every matter
verses.sale: Therein do the angels descend, and the spirit Gabriel also, by the permission of their Lord, with his decrees concerning every matter

verses.t: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
verses.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn
verses.yusufAli: Peace!... This until the rise of morn
verses.rodwell: And all is peace till the breaking of the morn
verses.sale: It is peace, until the rising of the morn
